rule: Numeric order is apply order. A persistent database never receives a version lower than its highest applied version (internal/migrations/run.sh refuses with OUT_OF_ORDER). A range therefore only takes new files while no persistent database has applied a higher number; once that happens the board allocates the lane a new range above the persistent maximum, or the trunk owner renumbers an unapplied file at integration (file rename only, content and checksum unchanged).
